lines.2: 「Someone must be talking about noble little me.」
lines.3: 「Mmm, Dobuzaka's famous food stalls really do live up to the hype! The kebabs and hot dogs are both delicious.」
lines.4: 「(Munch, munch. This yakisoba gets a seventy.)」
lines.5: 「You really can eat nothing but yakisoba, can't you, Takane?」
lines.7: 「Though you're clearly eating more than I am.」
lines.9: 「But you know, yakisoba is very high in calories, so you should watch yourself in all sorts of ways.」
lines.10: 「I don't have to worry about that sort of thing.」
lines.13: 「Oh? You barely ever talk, and this is when you decide to speak up, Poem?」
lines.16: 「We're conspicuous enough already. Couldn't you be a little quieter?」
lines.18: 「(Honestly... I don't know if they wanted a change of pace or what, but both Inugami sisters came along on my yakisoba gourmet tour.)」
lines.20: 「Yeah, no mistake. That's the actress Inugami Honami.」
lines.21: 「If Subaru, lover of big boobs, says so, then it has to be her!」
lines.22: 「And with someone that gorgeous, who cares if we've got the wrong person anyway!」
lines.23: 「Excuse me! Honami! I'm a huge fan! Can I get your autograph!?」
lines.24: 「Mmm, being popular is such a burden.」
lines.25: 「Whoa, he charged straight in without hesitating. Gotta give him credit for that.」
lines.26: 「There are so many people... It's embarrassing.」
lines.29: 「...Poem, isn't that gesture trying a little too hard to be cute?」
lines.31: 「U-um, Honami? About that autograph... Hah... hah...」
lines.33: 「Well, that's because you're just too beautiful, Honami.」
lines.35: 「Ngh... That's some serious sex appeal... No wonder she's an actress.」
lines.39: 「I'm sorry. She's in a hurry, so perhaps another time.」
